enrichment.directorySummary: Type-contract boundary for the file plugin facade. Normalizes the invocation envelope between the centralized dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and the commands/ container so CLI, web-tree, and AI JSON entry points share a single typed shape, preserving decoupling and workspace-containment guarantees without embedding runtime logic.
